reviews.author: Deal Hunter

reviews.title: Apevia is a great budget option
reviews.comment: I’ve used Apevia PSUs for years, and I’ve only had an issue once. Even then, they were quick to respond and swap out the PSU after helping try to troubleshoot. Just like previous PSUs I’ve had, this works perfectly and is basically future proof. 1000 watts and a new PCIE 5 port guarantees your good regardless of what parts you purchase. It runs quiet, is easy to install, and the cables are long enough regardless of the size of your case. I know some are quick to dismiss brands that aren’t high end, but I for one have been very happy with Apevia components.
reviews.author: techconsumer

reviews.title: It seems to be used
reviews.comment: The box seemed a bit damaged when I received the product. When I opened it, the accessories inside were messy and looked like they had been used before. What’s more, some cables were missing.

reviews.comment: After opening the package, I found the product didn’t match the description at all. Its performance was just average after installation and use, and I feel deceived.
